name: Sub-agent execution packet and parent review loop
question: Is every phase bounded, one sub-agent at a time, with required skills, packet-backed evidence, parent review, repair loop, and commit/push boundary?
finding_before: Section 6 named bounded sub-agent phases but did not require a concrete work-order packet.
The plan did not force required skills/guides to be loaded per phase.
The plan did not define a separate parent review packet.
The plan did not explicitly require repair before next phase when blocking/high findings remain.
The plan did not tie accepted changed files to commit/push boundary before further implementation.
recheck_evidence: Plan now requires bounded work orders with skills/guides, scope, authorization, track permissions, evidence packet, transcript quarantine, and interrupt behavior; parent review must accept scope, gate, overclaim, review, documentation, repair, and commit/push boundary before the next phase.
